articles.title: Navi Mumbai: Rohit Pawar, Jitendra Awhad Among NCP-SP Leaders Detained As Party Protests Over Recent Petrol, Diesel & LPG Price Hike - WATCH
articles.titleEn: Navi Mumbai: Rohit Pawar, Jitendra Awhad Among NCP-SP Leaders Detained As Party Protests Over Recent Petrol, Diesel & LPG Price Hike - WATCH
articles.summary: NCP-SP leader Rohit Pawar and other party leaders were detained by police during a protest in Navi Mumbai against recent hikes in petrol, diesel and LPG prices. The party symbolically lit a stove on the street to highlight inflation and unemployment. Pawar said the agitation aimed to draw attention to the daily struggles faced by common citizens.

Navi Mumbai: The Navi Mumbai Police on June 3 detained Nationalist Congress Party-Sharadchandra Pawar (NCP–SP) leader Rohit Pawar, along with other party leaders, who were protesting against the recent hikes in petrol, diesel, and LPG prices.

articles.title: Farmers protest, seek rollback of fuel & LPG price hike
articles.titleEn: Farmers protest, seek rollback of fuel & LPG price hike
articles.summary: Farmer unions under the banner of the Samyukt Kisan Morcha (SKM) staged a protest outside the Deputy Commissioner’s office on Tuesday, condemning the alleged police lathi-charge on protesting farmers on May 15 and demanding a rollback of increased diesel, petrol and cooking gas prices. They also sought an adequate supply of fertilisers and restoration of Punjab’s representation in the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB).
